feedback_text: The course was well-structured, but the weekly assignments were a bit too long.
I really enjoyed the guest lectures. They provided great real-world context.
The mid-term exam was much harder than the practice problems provided.
The professor explains complex concepts very clearly. Highly recommended.
I wish there were more office hours available. It's hard to get help.
The reading list was very diverse and interesting. I loved the poetry section.
The grading criteria for the essays were a bit ambiguous.
The lab sessions were disorganized and some equipment didn't work.
Great course overall, but the textbook is extremely expensive.
The online platform for submitting code was frequently down.
The TA was very helpful during the coding workshops.
The problem sets were challenging but rewarding.
I found the group discussion sessions a bit chaotic.
The lecture slides are a bit cluttered and hard to read.
I would appreciate more feedback on the early project drafts.
The exam review session was a lifesaver.
The final essay topic was very open-ended and creative.
I struggled with the calculus required for this physics course.
The collaborative project was the highlight of the semester.
The textbook examples don't match the homework difficulty.
The guest speaker on modern literature was fascinating.
The labs were too short for the amount of work required.
I loved the practical approach to software design.
The logic puzzles in the second half were quite abstract.
The peer review process was helpful for improving my writing.
